value.name: Asha arrives unprepared
value.description: Asha approaches Devin's building carrying her briefcase loosely and without a rehearsed next line, determined not to look argumentative.
evidence: she did not want to arrive looking like she had come to argue a position
she had no version of the next sentence rehearsed and was not going to find one standing here

value.name: Asha rings Devin's buzzer
value.description: At the vestibule, Asha presses the buzzer for Devin's apartment and waits for him to release the door.
evidence: At the vestibule she pressed the buzzer for 3B and waited through the small mechanical pause

value.name: Asha climbs to Devin's landing
value.description: After the door releases, Asha takes the stairs at an ordinary pace and settles on telling Devin about Whitfield first.
evidence: When the door released she took the stairs at an ordinary pace
she had settled on the only thing she was sure of, which was that she would tell him what she had said to Whitfield before she told him anything else

value.name: Asha knocks and waits in the doorway
value.description: Asha knocks firmly on Devin's door, steps back, and waits at the threshold when he opens it.
evidence: Asha knocked once, firm enough to carry through the door, and stepped back the small distance the landing allowed
Standing in the doorway with the briefcase loose at her side

value.name: Asha finds Devin at home
value.description: When Devin opens the door, Asha sees him in yesterday's shirt with the kitchen light on and an unfinished mug behind him.
evidence: When Devin opened it he was in yesterday's shirt with the cuffs pushed up
she could see behind him the kitchen light still on over a mug he had not finished

value.name: Asha delivers Whitfield correction
value.description: Without waiting to be invited in, Asha tells Devin she has come from Whitfield and explains the correction about the Tuesday filing and her delayed call.
evidence: She did not wait to be asked in.

she told him she had just come from Whitfield, that she had said the correction to the Tuesday filing went onto Devin's desk Monday morning before the caseworker took the stand and not after, and that she had not called him back at five forty-three because she had wanted the account to land without the two of them having spoken first

value.name: Devin reacts silently
value.description: After Asha finishes, she stops speaking and watches Devin's jaw tighten, signaling a tense reaction.
evidence: Then she stopped talking and stayed where she was, and watched his jaw set
